package.name: Timeline
package.description: A horizontal, Fusion 360-style feature timeline docked at the bottom of the FreeCAD window. Shows the active PartDesign body's features in order, with a draggable rollback marker, suppression toggles, renaming, deletion and drag-and-drop reordering. Every action is a single undo step.

other.name: Timeline
other.description: Bottom dock widget showing the active body's feature history. Loaded at startup by InitGui.py; it is not a workbench, so it stays available whichever workbench is active.
